**Stable ID:** `DATA-01.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 01 Scope, taxonomy and governance

Create the versioned taxonomy for modality, category, task family, domain, language and access that every record and Project field uses.

## Deliverables

- Versioned controlled vocabularies with definitions
- Mapping to external task taxonomies, recorded as references only

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/TAXONOMY.md`
- `schemas/taxonomy.schema.json`
- `planning/coverage-matrix.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each external taxonomy reference records its URL, access date and license or terms of use

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every Project single-select option maps to exactly one taxonomy term
- [ ] Every term has a definition and a scope note
- [ ] The validator rejects any record term that is not in the taxonomy

## Non-goals

- Copying external taxonomies wholesale without a rights review
- Ranking datasets

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-01.02.T1` Draft vocabularies
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T1.S1` Draft modality and category terms
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T1.S2` Draft task-family and domain terms
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T1.S3` Draft language and region conventions referencing ISO 639 and ISO 3166
- [ ] `DATA-01.02.T2` Cross-reference external taxonomies
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T2.S1` Compare against at least two public task taxonomies
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T2.S2` Record differences and rationale
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T2.S3` Record each source's terms-of-use status
- [ ] `DATA-01.02.T3` Encode and validate
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T3.S1` Write taxonomy.schema.json
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T3.S2` Add validator checks for unknown terms
  - [ ] `DATA-01.02.T3.S3` Add regression fixtures for rejected terms
